findings.title: Voice confirming state did not expose immutable candidate labels/options
findings.downstreamGate: None; corrected in current Software Architecture and Phase 10 contract correction
findings.resolution: VoiceSessionState.Confirming now exposes 1..2 immutable VoiceConfirmationOption values (optionIndex + displayLabel) bound to the current token; labels are ephemeral and prohibited from telemetry/persistence.

findings.title: PlaybackSnapshot runtime error projection was narrower than corrupt-media/interruption recovery model
findings.downstreamGate: None; corrected in current Software Architecture and Phase 10 contract correction
findings.resolution: PlaybackSnapshot lastError is interpreted as AppError? restricted to MediaItem, Playback or Interruption runtime categories; Controller failures remain connection/execute-level. This preserves observable asynchronous corrupt-media and safe-pause recovery without a new event bus.

findings.title: Static architecture cannot prove runtime Compose semantics, TalkBack order or 200% reflow
findings.owner: Issue #4 Android UI implementation + Issue #17 design handoff
findings.downstreamGate: Implementation Definition of Done / accessibility QA before affected feature completion
findings.resolution: Architecture ownership and wireframe requirements are explicit; runtime Compose semantics, focus order, 48dp targets, 200% text/reflow and non-color-only cues must be executed and tested downstream.

findings.title: Provider-specific cloud STT disclosure, retention/deletion and Legal approval are not selected
findings.downstreamGate: Before any remote/cloud STT activation and before release/Beta claim using that provider
findings.resolution: Remote/cloud speech remains disabled; local/manual paths remain available. No provider-specific approval is fabricated.

findings.title: Physical Pixel/Samsung/Xiaomi and three vehicle/head-unit execution remains downstream evidence
findings.resolution: Architecture/test slots are defined; no unperformed physical/OEM/vehicle result is claimed.
